image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a bright green leaf. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is light brown/tan with distinct rows of black eyespots (ocelli) ringed in yellow/white. The body appears fuzzy/hairy and brown. One antenna is clearly visible with a clubbed tip. The background is a soft-focus green bokeh.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The left antenna is clearly visible extending from the head, showing a distinct thickening at the tip characteristic of clubbed antennae.
